scheme_name: Pre Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students
other_conditions: Must be a student studying in Class 9th or Class 10th.
Must not be receiving any other government scholarship.
Scholarship is available only for studies in India and for one year.
Must be enrolled in a government school or a school recognized by the government or a central/state board of secondary education.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly stipend of ₹225 for day scholars or ₹525 for hostellers, plus annual book and ad‑hoc grants, with additional allowances for students with disabilities.
